tasks.label: MDE Demo: Phase 1 - Baseline Build
args: echo "=== Phase 1: Baseline Build (no optimizations) ===" && npm run compile

tasks.label: MDE Demo: Phase 2 - AV Exclusions
args: echo "=== Phase 2: AV Exclusions ===" && sudo mdatp exclusion folder add --path out && sudo mdatp exclusion folder add --path node_modules && sudo mdatp exclusion folder add --path .build && npm run compile && sudo mdatp exclusion folder remove --path out && sudo mdatp exclusion folder remove --path node_modules && sudo mdatp exclusion folder remove --path .build

tasks.label: MDE Demo: Phase 3 - Performance Profiles
args: echo "=== Phase 3: Performance Profiles ===" && sudo mdatp performance-profiles apply --name node && sudo mdatp performance-profiles apply --name vscode && sudo mdatp performance-profiles apply --name vscode-tree && sudo mdatp performance-profiles apply --name git && npm run compile && sudo mdatp performance-profiles remove --name node && sudo mdatp performance-profiles remove --name vscode && sudo mdatp performance-profiles remove --name vscode-tree && sudo mdatp performance-profiles remove --name git

tasks.label: MDE Demo: Cache sudo & Start
args: sudo -v && echo "sudo cached" && npm install && npm run compile
